mapper.select: SELECT account_types.id AS id, account_types.`name` AS name, account_types.chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, "-", chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, account_types.ordering AS ordering FROM account_types LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = account_types.chart_account_id ORDER BY account_types.ordering ASC
